members.risk: Full on ボウ/モウ and kun う; grade9, five strokes and canonical radical 卩 (26). The Rabbit sign is not the living rabbit noun 兎うさぎ; 卵 is a close shape comparison and 柳 contains the modern 卯 shape. Distinguish standalone卯's second lunar month from 卯月's fourth lunar month, historical east/hour senses, restricted year readings and search-only forms. ボウ has lexical candidates; モウ requires separate qualification.
